sentences.text: 300 Maritime Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-27 under the industry code 46180, agents in the wholesale of other particular products.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-10-02.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name contains a maritime word but the registered industry is wholesale agency work.
